创作一段 30 秒、1080p 的超写实个人家庭录像，内容是一位年轻韩国女性自信地尝试在她狭小的公寓里学习一个爆火的 TikTok 舞蹈趋势，而她的家具和协调性全程都在跟她作对。无参考图片。

**主要人物**

20 岁出头的年轻韩国女性，随性而坚定的气质，自然妆容，表情从专注自信转变为慌乱尴尬。

头发扎成凌乱的半丸子头，几缕发丝因她越来越慌乱而贴在脸上，戴着小巧的耳钉。

穿着超大号乐队 T 恤，松松地塞进骑行短裤里，白色短袜，不穿鞋，手机靠在地板上的一摞书上立着，用来“录下来练习”。

在整个视频中保持相同的面部、发型、服装、身体比例和外观。

**场景**

一间狭小、杂乱的单间公寓客厅，傍晚，温暖的灯光混合着笔记本电脑屏幕播放舞蹈教学视频的冷光。

一张咖啡桌被稍微推开但推得不够远，一盏落地灯立得离她的“舞台区域”有点太近，沙发上有一堆待洗衣物，边桌上有一杯半满的水，墙上有串灯，背景里有一辆室友的自行车靠在墙上。拥挤、真实，一间显然不是为跳舞而建的公寓。

**摄影机 / 视觉美学**

原始的个人录像，起初由她的室友用支起来的手机拍摄，事情出错后改为手持拍摄——后半段有强烈的手持 vlog 晃动。

“练习”镜头采用静态、略低角度的构图，模仿手机放在一摞书上的设置。画面没有完美居中，稍微切掉了她的头顶。一旦室友抓起手机，自动对焦会来回寻找，碰撞瞬间出现运动模糊，当她在灯光和阴影之间移动时曝光会变化，昏暗房间里有可见的数字噪点。

没有稳定，没有云台般的平滑，没有电影感运镜——它应该感觉像一段真实的手机录像，本来除了她之外没打算给任何人看。

---

**00:00–00:05 — 自信的准备**

她把手机靠在一摞书上，退回到画面中，像运动员热身一样甩动双臂。

她指着播放舞蹈教学视频的笔记本电脑屏幕，然后又指着自己，表情极其严肃。

*“Okay. I've watched this like twenty times. I got this.”*（“好吧。这个我看了大概二十遍了。我肯定行。”）

**00:05–00:10 — 第一个八拍**

音乐开始。她出人意料地完美完成了前几个动作，干脆而自信，动作中明显为自己感到骄傲。

室友的画外音，真心佩服：*“Wait, okay—?!”*（“等等，可以啊——？！”）

摄影机保持静止，以完整画幅捕捉她，一个难得的干净瞬间。

**00:10–00:15 — 第一次摇晃**

编舞中的一个快速转身让她措手不及——她慢了半秒才转，手臂乱挥想跟上，小腿撞到了咖啡桌边缘。

她尖叫一声，单脚跳着，仍咬紧牙关努力保持节奏。

*“I'm fine — I'm fine, keep going—”*（“我没事——我没事，继续——”)

**00:15–00:20 — 落地灯事件**

恢复过来后，她全力投入下一个大幅手臂动作——她的手撞到了落地灯，灯危险地倾斜。

她的室友冲进画面去扶住它，同时把手机从书上抓了起来，摄影机突然变成手持并晃动。

*“THE LAMP—”*（“灯——”)

**00:20–00:25 — 彻底混乱**

灯被救下了，但摄影机现在晃动且是手持的，她试图凭记忆重新接上编舞，越来越跟不上音乐，手臂朝着舞蹈从未设计过的方向乱挥。

她的手肘把边桌上的水杯撞掉，她甚至没有停下，只是做了个苦脸，继续在洒出的水中跳舞。

室友在现在不稳定的摄影机后面笑到不行：*“You're literally destroying the apartment—”*（“你真的在毁掉这间公寓——”)

**00:25–00:30 — 最后时刻**

歌曲结束。她摆出一个胜利的最终姿势——胸口起伏，一只手叉腰，完全喘不过气，水在她袜子附近积成一滩。

她看向镜头，尽管周围一片狼藉，却极其严肃。

*“...Post it. That was clean.”*（“……发出去。刚才很干净。”)

她的室友仍在笑，慢慢把镜头向下摇到洒出的水和倾倒的灯，然后转回她若无其事的脸——录像突然切黑。

---

**音频**

仅使用自然现场声：

除场景内笔记本电脑曲目外，不添加音乐。无旁白。无人工音效。

台词：*“Okay. I've watched this like twenty times. I got this.”*（“好吧。这个我看了大概二十遍了。我肯定行。”） / *“Wait, okay—?!”*（“等等，可以啊——？！”）（室友） / *“I'm fine — I'm fine, keep going—”*（“我没事——我没事，继续——”) / *“THE LAMP—”*（“灯——”）（室友） / *“You're literally destroying the apartment—”*（“你真的在毁掉这间公寓——”）（室友） / *“...Post it. That was clean.”*（“……发出去。刚才很干净。”)

**最终感觉**

混乱、狭小公寓的能量——那种自信地尝试爆火舞蹈，然后立刻与自己家具打输一架的普遍经历。有趣、肢体化、感觉未经编排，结尾的冷面笑点更有力，因为她真的完全不承认周围的破坏。

除了真实的肢体失误外，不要夸张的闹剧式打闹。不需要专业舞蹈技巧——喜剧来自真实的动量、真实的险些撞上，以及她完全拒绝认输。

extra-f8d859eff485.en:
Douyin viral cool motorcycle transition video🎬

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16 vertical
Overall style: Photorealistic Urban Night Ride short film (Photorealistic Urban Night Ride), strong impact action match cut (Impact Match Cut), speed ramp (Speed Ramp), low-angle chase, high-speed motion blur, 4K cinematic quality
Characters: male lead @图片1 (Image 1), female lead @图片2 (Image 2); strictly keep the faces, hairstyles, body types and character identities of the two reference images consistent
Wardrobe: male lead wears a black fitted jacket, black trousers, white sneakers; female lead wears a black long-sleeve fitted short dress, black knee-high boots, long hair naturally loose
Scene: city riverside night road, high-rise building cluster covered in red lights, golden traditional buildings, cross-river bridge, blue-white guardrails and rapidly receding city lights
Motorcycle: black sport naked bike, a few red accent lines, bright white headlight, red taillight, wide real tires; no brand logos
Audio: no dialogue, no subtitles; strong-rhythm electronic music, sprinting footsteps, low-frequency impact transition sound, engine burst, high-speed wind noise and gear-shift sounds

SHOT 1｜High-speed carry-and-transition to motorcycle (00:00-01:00)

Subject:
Female lead waits by the river, male lead rushes in at high speed, scoops her up in one motion, the two burst out of frame by inertia, instantly transitioning to the motorcycle speeding out.

Action:

00:00-00:12:
Locked-off full-body shot. Female lead stands alone slightly right of center, appears for only about 0.12 seconds; night wind blows her long hair, distant red city buildings bright and clear.

00:12-00:35:
Music suddenly hits hard. Male lead rushes in diagonally from the left rear of frame at high speed, very fast, body with strong directional motion blur, black jacket pulled straight back by wind.

Camera whips rapidly to the right (Fast Whip Pan), producing brief strong speed streaks. Male lead must not slow down, must not stop, must not approach slowly.

00:35-00:55:
The instant male lead reaches the female lead, his arms directly wrap around her waist, scooping her off the ground.

Female lead is carried by the sprint inertia, feet immediately leave the ground, arms instinctively wrap around male lead's shoulders and neck, long hair and legs simultaneously swing toward the left rear of frame.

After catching her, male lead does not stop a single step, continues charging toward the right front of frame at original speed. The action is not a stationary hug, not hugging after standing steady, but “carrying her away directly during a high-speed rush-in.”

Add two frames of real impact camera shake (Impact Camera Shake) and a low “boom” at the moment of the catch.

00:55-00:75:
Male lead carrying female lead sweeps past almost brushing the camera at high speed. Male lead's black shoulder and back, female lead's flying black long hair and skirt hem rapidly fill the entire frame.

The two rush toward the right side of frame and completely exit frame. When black clothing fills the lens, no pause, no fade-out.

00:75-01:00:
The black clothing filling the lens directly action-match hard cuts to the front fairing and nose of a black motorcycle.

Motorcycle headlight suddenly lights up, front wheel rushes from lower left of frame close to the lens toward right front at high speed; engine sound bursts instantly, body sweeps past lens producing strong wind pressure and motion blur.

Camera immediately whips right to catch up with the motorcycle, revealing male lead already seated in front driving, female lead already seated on the rear seat. The motorcycle's direction of movement is completely consistent with the direction the two burst out of frame in the previous shot.

Environment:
Same city riverside night scene, spatial continuity maintained through black occlusion and motion direction.

Camera:
Locked-off full-body shot→fast whip pan→lens-brushing occlusion→low-angle motorcycle rushing at lens→rapid chase. The entire segment must complete within one second.

Style:
The first second is the biggest visual hook, action short, fast, heavy, no slow motion.

Constraints:
Male lead must first catch female lead, female lead's feet clearly off the ground, only then do the two burst out of frame together; female lead must not jump up by herself, the two must not stop in the middle of frame.

SHOT 2｜Black-red motorcycle high-speed night ride (01:00-06:10)

Subject:
Male lead drives the black-red motorcycle, female lead sits on the rear seat, speeding between the red city skyline and the cross-river bridge.

Action:

01:00-01:55:
Ultra-low ground-level tracking shot (Ground-level Tracking). Camera very close to the front wheel, tire spinning at high speed, white road markings rapidly sweeping under the wheel.

Camera pulls up along the body: male lead wears all-black clothing and a black full-face helmet, body leaning forward, hands firmly on handlebars; female lead sits on the rear seat, legs stably on both footpegs, one hand around male lead's waist.

Motorcycle rapidly upshifts, engine pitch clearly rises.

01:55-02:80:
Cut to side parallel chase shot. Motorcycle speeds past golden traditional buildings and blue high-rises, characters stay clear, background lights form horizontal speed light bands.

Female lead leans out from behind male lead's shoulder, looks at the parallel camera, first waves at the lens, then makes a playful gesture beside her face.

Male lead always looks forward, does not turn back, does not release the handlebars.

02:80-03:55:
Camera suddenly drops beside the rear wheel, moving at high speed close to the black-red body. Rear wheel spins, chain moves, suspension slightly compresses, red body lines sweep past in front of the lens.

Motorcycle bursts out from under the bridge lights, camera rapidly rises into a wide side shot. Red high-rise cluster fills the entire background behind the two.

03:55-04:60:
Female lead, seated steady, briefly spreads both arms, head raised into the wind; then raises both hands above her head, forming a clear heart shape.

Camera rapidly moves around the motorcycle from the left side to the left front (Fast Arc Tracking), headlight, red buildings and blue-white guardrails form strong depth.

Motorcycle keeps high-speed straight-line travel, no wheelies, no drifting.

04:60-05:45:
Frontal low-angle tracking. Motorcycle rapidly approaches from a distance, bright headlight facing the lens, tires almost touching the camera car.

Male lead slightly lowers his body, completes one clear gear shift; motorcycle accelerates again, body lunges forward.

Female lead ends the heart gesture, one hand returns to male lead's waist, the other reaches toward the camera, palm growing larger and rapidly covering the entire lens.

05:45-06:10:
Female lead's black cuff and palm completely fill the lens, triggering the second hard cut.

After the occlusion clears, male and female leads have both put on matching black full-face helmets. Both helmets have complete visors, visors fully pulled down from the forehead position, covering eyes, nose and mouth; city red light clearly reflected on the visor surface.

Camera:
Ultra-close tire shot→side chase→rear-wheel close tracking→fast arc orbit→frontal low-angle approach→palm occludes lens.

Style:
Camera maintains sense of speed and mechanical weight, background lights streaked but body and characters clear.

Constraints:
Motorcycle always the same black-red sport naked bike; male lead always driving, female lead always on the rear seat.

SHOT 3｜Duo full-helmet finale chase (06:10-10:00)

Subject:
Male and female leads both wear complete black full-face helmets, dark visors pulled down, riding the black-red motorcycle through a cooler, faster night chase finale.

Action:

06:10-07:05:
Black-frame occlusion cuts to frontal chase shot. Motorcycle headlight pierces the night, rapidly approaching the lens.

Male lead wears black full-face helmet, dark visor fully pulled down, body low controlling handlebars; female lead also wears black full-face helmet, complete visor pulled down, head leaning out from male lead's shoulder side.

Both helmets must each completely cover the head, must not show only half a helmet, must not lack chin protection structure, must not turn the visor into glasses.

07:05-08:00:
